title: Black Gowns, a ₹2.3-Crore Watch, and the Night Bollywood Dressed to Kill: Inside the Style Icons Awards 2026
excerpt: Akshay Kumar, Shahid Kapoor, Sharvari, and three dozen of Bollywood's sharpest showed up at Mumbai's JW Marriott — and walked away with the year's most glamorous trophies.
body:
The fourth edition of the **Bollywood Hungama Style Icons Summit and Awards** swept through **JW Marriott, Juhu** on June 24 like a monsoon of sequins and couture — and by the time the last trophy was handed out, it had crowned practically half the industry.

Let's start with what everybody saw first: the red carpet.

## The Looks That Stopped the Room

**Vaani Kapoor** arrived in a pristine black gown with structural minimalism so sharp it could cut glass — a monochromatic column silhouette that made every other outfit in the room suddenly feel like it was trying too hard. She walked away with Most Stylish Haute Stepper of the Year, and honestly, the category might as well have been invented for her. Behind the scenes, Vaani also dropped a quiet bombshell during the day's panel discussions: she's turned screenwriter.

> "I am enjoying the process. It's new and keeping me happy… acting remains my first love." — Vaani Kapoor

**Pooja Hegde** went the opposite direction — a dramatic draped fabric pattern in a light-moving high-fashion design that was equal parts modern Indian and international editorial. She took home Most Stylish Pan-India Icon of the Year. **Huma Qureshi** stunned in all-black power dressing paired with dark-glam makeup, winning Mega Performer of the Year (Female). And then there was **Ananya Birla**, who paired a baby-pink bouclé-tweed duster coat with relaxed denim and pointed olive-green heels — and on her wrist, a watch worth **₹2.30 crore**. She collected the Most Stylish Business Leader award and also celebrated *Main Vaapas Aaunga* winning Iconic Film of the Year.

The jewellery alone deserved its own category. **Aditi Rao Hydari** wore diamond and emerald pieces from Indriya that practically glowed under the flashbulbs. **Sharvari Wagh** balanced youthful sophistication with contemporary statement jewellery that cemented her status as one of Bollywood's fastest-rising style forces. **Ananya Panday** kept it sleek and minimal — understated luxury that whispered rather than shouted.

## The Winners Who Mattered

The big trophies told the story of Bollywood's year so far. **Akshay Kumar** was crowned The People's Superstar and Style Icon — a nod to the Khiladi's enduring hold on Indian cinema's imagination, arriving just two days before his *Welcome to the Jungle* opened to a ₹15-crore day. **Shahid Kapoor** took Icon of Indian Cinema, riding the wave of *Cocktail 2*'s ₹128-crore worldwide run.

https://www.instagram.com/p/DaCtoXSjXQy/

**Ayushmann Khurrana** was named Power-Packed Performer of the Year (Male) for *Thamma*, while **Ananya Panday** received Standout Performance of the Year (Female) for her work in *Kesari 2*. **Sharvari** — who's having a career year between *Main Vaapas Aaunga* and the upcoming *Alpha* — won Mega Performer of the Year (Female, Popular Choice).

The film that dominated the night? **Main Vaapas Aaunga**, Imtiaz Ali's Diljit Dosanjh-led sleeper hit that opened to just ₹1 crore and refused to stop running. It took Iconic Film of the Year, while Imtiaz Ali was named Iconic Filmmaker of the Year. A quiet film sweeping the loudest awards night of the season — sometimes the industry gets it right.

**Rajkummar Rao** won Iconic Actor of the Year. **Bhumi Pednekar** picked up Outstanding Performance in a Leading Role (Female) for *Daldal*. **Arshad Warsi** won the same category for men. **Vedang Raina** — the young actor who's quickly becoming impossible to ignore — was given Breakthrough Performance of the Year.

And in a moment that quieted the room, **Nawazuddin Siddiqui** — named Most Stylish Splendid Performer (Male) — shared a story from his earliest days during the Summit's panel discussions.

> "My mother had loaned her jewellery. She was able to get it back…" — Nawazuddin Siddiqui, on his first paycheque

Other standouts: **Sonu Sood** (Social Impact Icon of Indian Showbiz), **Boman Irani** (Timeless Screen Icon of Indian Cinema), **Ali Fazal** (Most Stylish Pathbreaking Star, Male), **Milind Soman and Ankita Konwar** (Global Icons — the Ironman couple), and **Rasha Thadani** (Most Stylish Groundbreaking Star — the newest gen-next name to watch).

## What It All Means

The Bollywood Hungama Style Icons night has quietly become the year's most reliable temperature check on who's actually exciting right now — not just who has the biggest release, but who commands a room. This year's winners are dominated by performers who took creative risks: Ayushmann in a dark role, Bhumi in a gritty drama, Sharvari stepping into the spy universe, Shahid proving rom-coms can still print money.

For the Indian diaspora watching from abroad, the night's real headline might be simpler: Bollywood's A-list has never looked this polished, this international, and this unapologetically glamorous. The industry is dressing like it knows the world is watching.

And Vaani Kapoor is writing screenplays now. 2026 keeps delivering.
